class: Independent writes corrupt an auto-advancing composite date
symptom: Waystar self-identification Month and Day writes changed neighboring segments and the form rejected the date.
root_cause: PageAgent handled date segments as independent inputs even though Workday consumes a digit stream and advances focus between segments.
why_tests_missed: Numeric input coverage lacked a composite widget that clears and auto-advances between segments.
fix: Recognize Workday date segment metadata, write the contiguous composite digit stream, and verify all segment values while preserving neighbors.
prevention: Test composite date behavior and verify the whole date instead of only the edited segment.
